questions.explanation: A buffer absorbs variation in arrival time so playback stays smooth, and the client can start before the whole object is present. For live media, late packets are often useless, so applications may tolerate some loss rather than wait for retransmission. Streaming still runs over a transport protocol; it simply makes different trade-offs about timeliness. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
